mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(MESSAGE_ORDER), -1) FROM `AI_CHAT_MESSAGE` WHERE DELETED = 0 AND MEMORY_KEY = #{messageKey}
SELECT ACM.* FROM `AI_CHAT_MESSAGE` ACM WHERE ACM.DELETED = 0 AND ACM.MEMORY_KEY = #{memoryKey} ORDER BY ACM.UPDATE_TIME ASC
SELECT MODEL_KEY AS modelKey, SUM(TOTAL_TOKENS) AS total FROM `AI_CHAT_MESSAGE` WHERE CREATE_TIME >= CURDATE() AND DELETED = 0 AND ENV_CODE = #{envCode} GROUP BY MODEL_KEY
